title: Oil Rich Saudi Arabian Chicken Pilaf
description: A rich and fluffy Saudi Arabian dish featuring chicken, birds-eye chillies, and caramelized onions, made diabetic-friendly with brown rice and minimal oil.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Add the birds-eye chillies and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the saucepan and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the brown rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the chicken and onion mixture.
Add 4 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
